1.explanation: We prepare an Angular-style HTML snippet containing pipes with both literal (string/number) arguments and a more complex case (object argument). Using Prettier 2.8.0 with the built-in Angular parser (parser: 'angular'), it will insert spaces around the colon separators for every pipe argument, regardless of type. Running the Node.js script or the CLI command demonstrates the regression introduced in 2.8.0. To reproduce the bug, simply install Prettier@2.8.0, configure the parser to 'angular', and invoke format on the template file or code string.
